data.title: Unit 4: Food and diet
Carnivores, herbivores and omnivores
data.text: Animals that eat only plants are called herbivores.
Because plants provide less energy than meat, herbivores spend much more time eating than carnivores.
Cows and buffaloes eat grass and hay.
Animals that eat both plants and meat are called omnivores.
Chickens eat grain, egg shells, and worms.
